description: BIGINT_UUID25 baseline: numeric identity, UUID pair verification without UUID indexes
statements:
CREATE TABLE users (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
username VARCHAR(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin UNIQUE NOT NULL,
password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
role VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('ADMIN','EDITOR','VIEWER','RELEASER')),
active TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN(0,1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE sessions (
token_hash VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin PRIMARY KEY,
user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
expires_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
INDEX(expires_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE companies (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')) DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
remark VARCHAR(2000),
address TEXT,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
UNIQUE(code)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE factories (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')) DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
remark VARCHAR(2000),
address TEXT,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),
UNIQUE(company_id,code),
UNIQUE(id,company_id),
INDEX(company_id,status),
timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Shanghai'
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE partners (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')) DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
remark VARCHAR(2000),
address TEXT,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),
contact_name VARCHAR(200),
phone VARCHAR(100),
supplier_capabilities JSON NOT NULL CHECK(JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["MATERIAL","PROCESSING"]},"uniqueItems":true,"minItems":0}',supplier_capabilities)),
UNIQUE(company_id,code),
UNIQUE(id,company_id),
INDEX(company_id,status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE partner_roles (
partner_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
role VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('CUSTOMER','SUPPLIER')),
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','INACTIVE')),
PRIMARY KEY(partner_id,role),
FOREIGN KEY(partner_id) REFERENCES partners(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE warehouses (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')) DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
remark VARCHAR(2000),
address TEXT,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
location_type VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(location_type IN ('INTERNAL','SUPPLIER')) DEFAULT 'INTERNAL',
custodian_supplier_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),
FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(custodian_supplier_id,company_id) REFERENCES partners(id,company_id),
UNIQUE(factory_id,code),
UNIQUE(id,company_id,factory_id),
CHECK((location_type='INTERNAL' AND custodian_supplier_id IS NULL) OR (location_type='SUPPLIER' AND custodian_supplier_id IS NOT NULL)),
INDEX(company_id,factory_id,status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE locations (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')) DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
remark VARCHAR(2000),
address TEXT,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
warehouse_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
usage_hint VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(usage_hint IN ('GENERAL','RAW','WIP','FINISHED','QUARANTINE')) DEFAULT 'GENERAL',
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),
FOREIGN KEY(warehouse_id,company_id,factory_id) REFERENCES warehouses(id,company_id,factory_id),
UNIQUE(warehouse_id,code),
INDEX(warehouse_id,status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE units (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')) DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
remark VARCHAR(2000),
address TEXT,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
dimension VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(dimension IN ('COUNT','MASS','LENGTH','VOLUME','OTHER')),
decimal_places INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(decimal_places BETWEEN 0 AND 6),
UNIQUE(code)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE material_categories (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')) DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
remark VARCHAR(2000),
address TEXT,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
parent_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),
UNIQUE(company_id,code),
UNIQUE(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(parent_id,company_id) REFERENCES material_categories(id,company_id),
INDEX(company_id,parent_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE materials (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')) DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
remark VARCHAR(2000),
address TEXT,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
category_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
material_kind VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin  CHECK(material_kind IN ('RAW','SEMI','FINISHED')),
specification TEXT,
base_unit_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
tracking_mode VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(tracking_mode IN ('NONE','BATCH','SERIAL','BATCH_SERIAL')) DEFAULT 'BATCH',
serial_uniqueness VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin  CHECK(serial_uniqueness IN ('MATERIAL')),
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),
FOREIGN KEY(category_id,company_id) REFERENCES material_categories(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(base_unit_id) REFERENCES units(id),
UNIQUE(company_id,code),
UNIQUE(id,company_id),
INDEX(company_id,status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE material_units (
material_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
unit_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factor DECIMAL(20,6) NOT NULL CHECK(factor>0),
PRIMARY KEY(material_id,unit_id),
FOREIGN KEY(material_id) REFERENCES materials(id),
FOREIGN KEY(unit_id) REFERENCES units(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE material_factory_policies (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
material_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
allowed_supply_modes JSON NOT NULL CHECK(JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["BUY","MAKE","SUBCONTRACT"]},"uniqueItems":true,"minItems":1}',allowed_supply_modes)),
default_supply_mode VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(default_supply_mode IN ('BUY','MAKE','SUBCONTRACT')),
allowed_production_strategies JSON NOT NULL CHECK(JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["MTO","MTS"]},"uniqueItems":true,"minItems":0}',allowed_production_strategies)),
default_production_strategy VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin  CHECK(default_production_strategy IN ('MTO','MTS')),
preferred_supplier_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
status VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','INACTIVE')),
UNIQUE(material_id,factory_id),
FOREIGN KEY(material_id,company_id) REFERENCES materials(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(preferred_supplier_id,company_id) REFERENCES partners(id,company_id),
CHECK(JSON_CONTAINS(allowed_supply_modes,JSON_QUOTE(default_supply_mode))),
CHECK((NOT JSON_OVERLAPS(allowed_supply_modes,JSON_ARRAY('MAKE','SUBCONTRACT'))) OR (JSON_LENGTH(allowed_production_strategies)>0 AND default_production_strategy IS NOT NULL AND JSON_CONTAINS(allowed_production_strategies,JSON_QUOTE(default_production_strategy)))),
CHECK(default_production_strategy IS NULL OR JSON_CONTAINS(allowed_production_strategies,JSON_QUOTE(default_production_strategy))),
INDEX(factory_id,status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE material_inspection_policies (
policy_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
inspection_type VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(inspection_type IN ('IQC','FQC','OQC')),
requirement VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL CHECK(requirement IN ('REQUIRED','EXEMPT')),
exemption_reason TEXT,
PRIMARY KEY(policy_id,inspection_type),
FOREIGN KEY(policy_id) REFERENCES material_factory_policies(id),
CHECK((requirement='EXEMPT' AND exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(exemption_reason))>0) OR (requirement='REQUIRED' AND exemption_reason IS NULL))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE user_company_scopes (
user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY(user_id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE user_factory_scopes (
user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY(user_id,factory_id),
FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(factory_id) REFERENCES factories(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
actor_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
action VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
entity_type VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
entity_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
entity_uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
before_json JSON,
after_json JSON,
reason TEXT,
occurred_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users(id),
INDEX(entity_type,entity_id,occurred_at),
INDEX(company_id,factory_id),
company_uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
factory_uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
snapshot_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 2 CHECK(snapshot_version IN (1,2))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE factory_calendars (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
year INT NOT NULL CHECK(year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100),
status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')),
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
remark VARCHAR(2000),
activated_at DATETIME(6),
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
UNIQUE(factory_id,year),
FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
INDEX(company_id,factory_id,status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE calendar_week_patterns (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
calendar_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
valid_from DATE NOT NULL,
valid_to DATE NOT NULL,
work_days JSON NOT NULL,
CHECK(valid_to>valid_from),
CHECK(JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"array","items":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":7},"uniqueItems":true,"maxItems":7}',work_days)),
FOREIGN KEY(calendar_id) REFERENCES factory_calendars(id),
INDEX(calendar_id,valid_from)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE calendar_exceptions (
calendar_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
date DATE NOT NULL,
day_type VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(day_type IN ('WORK','REST')),
note VARCHAR(500),
PRIMARY KEY(calendar_id,date),
FOREIGN KEY(calendar_id) REFERENCES factory_calendars(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE work_centers (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL,
remark VARCHAR(2000),
status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')),
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
UNIQUE(factory_id,code),
UNIQUE(id,company_id,factory_id),
FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
INDEX(company_id,factory_id,status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE numbering_rules (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
purpose VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('MO','LOT','SN')),
scope_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
scope_type VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(scope_type IN ('COMPANY','FACTORY')),
code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
prefix VARCHAR(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
date_format VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(date_format IN ('NONE','YYYY','YYYYMM','YYYYMMDD')),
sequence_width INT NOT NULL CHECK(sequence_width BETWEEN 3 AND 10),
reset_period VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(reset_period IN ('NONE','YEAR','MONTH','DAY')),
timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')),
activated_at DATETIME(6),
remark VARCHAR(2000),
revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
UNIQUE(company_id,code),
UNIQUE(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),
FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),
CHECK((scope_type='COMPANY' AND factory_id IS NULL AND scope_key='C') OR (scope_type='FACTORY' AND factory_id IS NOT NULL AND scope_key REGEXP '^F:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$')),
INDEX(company_id,factory_id,status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE numbering_counters (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
purpose VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('MO','LOT','SN')),
scope_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
reset_period VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(reset_period IN ('NONE','YEAR','MONTH','DAY')),
period_key VARCHAR(8) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
current_value BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(current_value BETWEEN 0 AND 9999999999),
UNIQUE(company_id,purpose,scope_key,reset_period,period_key),
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),
FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),
INDEX(company_id,factory_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE number_allocations (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
uuid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
factory_id BIGINT UNSIGNED,
purpose VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('MO','LOT','SN')),
scope_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
rule_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
request_key VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
fingerprint CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
business_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK(business_type IN ('production-order','production-batch','product-serial-batch')),
business_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
quantity INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
numbering_date DATE NOT NULL,
period_key VARCHAR(8) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
rule_snapshot JSON NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
UNIQUE(company_id,purpose,request_key),
UNIQUE(company_id,purpose,business_type,business_id),
UNIQUE(id,company_id,purpose),
FOREIGN KEY(rule_id,company_id) REFERENCES numbering_rules(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),
FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),
FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),
INDEX(company_id,factory_id,created_at),
snapshot_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 2 CHECK(snapshot_version IN (1,2))

CREATE TABLE number_allocation_items (
allocation_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
company_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
purpose VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('MO','LOT','SN')),
ordinal INT NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
sequence_value BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(sequence_value BETWEEN 1 AND 9999999999),
number VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY(allocation_id,ordinal),
UNIQUE(company_id,purpose,number),
FOREIGN KEY(allocation_id,company_id,purpose) REFERENCES number_allocations(id,company_id,purpose)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin
